carpet.rule.debugLog.name: Debug log
carpet.rule.debugLog.desc: Print verbose logs of this mod for troubleshooting.
carpet.rule.debugLog.extra.0: Only changes log verbosity; no gameplay effect.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSpawnPreload.name: Fake player spawn preload
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSpawnPreload.desc: With /player <name> spawn, resolve the player profile (UUID and skin) in the background first and spawn afterwards, so the spawn does not stall the server. If resolution takes longer than 0.3s, progress is shown above the hotbar.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSpawnPreload.extra: Each name is preloaded once; if resolution fails the spawn still happens with the offline fallback.
Disable to restore Carpet's original spawn flow.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerRejoinKeepRiding.n: Keep the vehicle when a bot comes back
carpet.rule.fakePlayerRejoinKeepRiding.d: Puts a fake player back on the vehicle it was riding when it comes online again: works with Carpet TIS Addition's /player <name> rejoin and with GugleCarpetAddition's fakePlayerResident (bots restored after a server restart).
carpet.rule.fakePlayerRejoinKeepRiding.e: The vehicle UUID is read from RootVehicle in playerdata and the bot is re-mounted once that chunk is loaded. It only re-mounts and never spawns a vehicle, so there are no duplicate carts.
The vehicle must be within 8 blocks and the mod waits at most 15 seconds, so /player <name> spawn elsewhere never drags the bot back to an old vehicle.
carpet.rule.commandBatchPlayerAction.des: Enables batch fake player actions: every /player action is mounted under Carpet Org Addition's batch command next to its spawn/kill/drop, with tab completion for actions and their arguments. Values: false / true / ops / 0-4, same as commandPlayer.
carpet.rule.commandBatchPlayerAction.ext: Usage: /playerManager batch <prefix> <start> <end> <action>, e.g. batch bot 1 45 use continuous or batch bot 1 45 stop.
Targets follow Carpet Org's convention: batch bot 1 45 means bot_1..bot_45; prefix all or * targets every fake player.
spawn/kill/drop/trial keep Carpet Org's own implementation and are not overridden.
carpet.rule.minecartChunkLoader.name: Minecart chunk loader
carpet.rule.minecartChunkLoader.desc: Enables the minecart chunk loader: every minecartScanInterval ticks (default 100) it scans once and, for matching carts standing on a matching rail or carried by a piston, grants loading tickets around them to keep chunks loaded and ticking.
carpet.rule.minecartChunkLoader.extra.0: Also needs minecartLoaderTypes, minecartLoaderRails and minecartLoaderRange.
carpet.rule.minecartChunkLoader.extra.1: Tickets last 15 seconds, or 30 seconds for carts that did not move: after a cart leaves the rail or disappears, chunks unload within 30 seconds and nothing is left behind.
carpet.rule.minecartLoaderTypes.name: Loader cart types
carpet.rule.minecartLoaderTypes.desc: Cart type that triggers loading (preset, single choice): minecart / chest_minecart / hopper_minecart / tnt_minecart / spawner_minecart / command_block_minecart / furnace_minecart. Default: minecart.
carpet.rule.minecartLoaderRails.name: Loader rail types
carpet.rule.minecartLoaderRails.desc: Rail type that triggers loading (preset, single choice): detector_rail / rail / powered_rail / activator_rail. Default: detector_rail.
carpet.rule.minecartLoaderRange.name: Loader radius
carpet.rule.minecartLoaderRange.desc: Chunk radius kept loaded around the cart, 1-32, default 2.
carpet.rule.minecartLoaderRange.extra.0: The number of covered chunks grows with the square of the radius - keep it small.
carpet.rule.minecartScanInterval.name: Loader scan interval
carpet.rule.minecartScanInterval.desc: Scan interval in ticks, default 100 (about 5 seconds at 20 tps). Rail checks, ticket renewal and discovery of new carts all happen in this one pass; only loaded chunks are scanned.
carpet.rule.minecartScanInterval.extra.0: Smaller means faster detection (a cart may only sit on the rail for 2 ticks per machine cycle) but an entity sweep and ticket grants every pass; larger is cheaper but may miss.
carpet.rule.minecartScanInterval.extra.1: When a cart stays in the same chunk on two consecutive grants, it switches to the 30-second ticket, giving parked machines twice the slack.
carpet.rule.minecartLoaderTypes.extra.0: One rule matches one cart type; the old comma separated list is no longer accepted.
carpet.rule.minecartLoaderRails.extra.0: One rule matches one rail type; the old comma separated list is no longer accepted.
carpet.rule.commandPlayerLoadRange.name: Player load range command
carpet.rule.commandPlayerLoadRange.desc: Enables /player <bot> load [radius|default] to enlarge a single fake player's chunk loading range. Enlarge only - it can never go below the server view distance. Values: false / true / ops / 0-4, same as commandPlayer.
carpet.rule.commandPlayerLoadRange.extra: For example /player bot1 load 10; /player bot1 load default restores the server view distance behaviour.

Tickets are force-added at the bot's current chunk every 20 ticks and never removed: chunk tickets have no reference count, so removing one would also drop another bot's shared ticket. Old spots expire on their own after 15 seconds.
carpet.rule.betaTransparentNightmarishBl: Turns vaults, ominous vaults, trial spawners and budding amethyst into ghost blocks: blast resistant, unbreakable, not a redstone conductor, and non-player entities pass through. Pistons push through them and the block is restored with its original state (an ominous vault stays ominous). While enabled, amethyst buds stop growing.
Options: false / trial (vault + ominous vault + trial spawner) / amethyst (budding amethyst) / both.
Players (including fake players) still collide; only non-player entities - TNT, minecarts, item entities, mobs - pass through.
A pending restore waits at most 15 minutes, then it is written to disk and retried on the next server start.
carpet.rule.namedItemChunkLoader.name: Item chunk loader
carpet.rule.namedItemChunkLoader.desc: Only a dropped item renamed to "区块加载器" acts as a chunk loader: every 5 seconds it grants strong loading tickets to the surrounding 3x3 chunks (entity ticking). The item despawns after 5 minutes and loading stops.
carpet.rule.namedItemChunkLoader.extra.0: The name must match exactly; items with any other name (including ordinary farm drops) never load chunks.
carpet.rule.namedItemChunkLoader.extra.1: The 3x3 chunks are entity ticking; one further ring is loaded without ticking. Tickets expire after 15 seconds, so loading stops at most 15 seconds after the item disappears.
carpet.rule.namedItemChunkLoader.extra.2: At most 256 loaders at a time; nothing is persisted across restarts, drop a new item instead.
carpet.rule.namedItemChunkLoaderName.des: The item name that turns a dropped item into a chunk loader. Defaults to "区块加载器". Exact match, case sensitive.
carpet.rule.namedItemChunkLoaderName.ext: Change it to e.g. "loader" and only items named loader will load chunks.
